title: Add benchmark lab profiling baselines and reporting pipeline v128
author: Ava Patel
release_notes: Adds v128 profiling baselines, representative workload runners, and a reporting pipeline. Includes telemetry normalizers and a dashboard export for benchlab team.
description: Motivation: refresh profiling baselines and reporting for the benchmark lab to capture recent kernel-selection, quantization, and batching changes. This PR adds v128 profiling baselines, updates representative workload runners (include multi-variant + webrtc cases), and wires a new reporting pipeline that normalizes telemetry and emits both JSON/CSV outputs used by dashboards and automated regression checks. Changes include runner improvements to seed workloads deterministically, added KV cache cold-start harnesses, and a reporting pipeline with improved aggregation by kernel/config/model. Checklist: - [x] Add profiling baselines v128 - [x] Update representative workload runners and tests - [x] Add reporting pipeline v128 (JSON/CSV + dashboard export) - [x] Add telemetry normalizer and unit tests - [x] Update docs/benchmark-lab README - [x] Add CI bench-e2e job and flakiness guard How tested: ran full benchmark-lab perf suite locally and on CI, verified baseline generation and dashboard import, validated CSV/JSON outputs against existing v127 outputs (delta within expected thresholds), ran end-to-end reporting pipeline in staging. Rollback plan: revert the pipeline yaml and baseline artifacts; previous baselines remain available under v127. Related: ENG-1423, PERF-88, SUP-623. Notes: this PR intentionally keeps diffs small per file and delegates large artifact uploads to the artifactory job; artifact manifests are included so CI can fetch baselines.
commits: Initial scaffolding for profiling baselines v128
